_comment: Optris Thermal Monitor config. Edit fire_monitor thresholds to match your scene.

fire_monitor._comment_threshold: Candidate created when any pixel exceeds absolute_threshold_c OR rises more than relative_threshold_c above the scene average.
fire_monitor._comment_warning: WARNING fires after hotspot stays >= threshold + warning_rise_c for warning_window_s seconds continuously.
fire_monitor._comment_alarm: ALARM fires after hotspot stays >= threshold + alarm_rise_c for alarm_window_s seconds continuously.
